final: WITH project_counts AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), shares AS (SELECT arcref, qc_count, CAST(qc_count AS REAL) / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share FROM project_counts), ranked AS (SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY share - AVG(share) OVER () DESC) AS rn FROM shares) SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, deviation FROM ranked WHERE deviation >= (SELECT deviation FROM ranked WHERE rn = 10) ORDER BY deviation DESC
